title: Profiles: implement-tick, review-epic, closeout-epic resolve to executor, runner, model, prompt
description: internal/profile: three role profiles, each exactly {executor, runner, model, prompt} (SPEC §4.5 Phase 1 rule: nothing else), versioned, resolved from a profiles/ directory in this repo with provenance recorded in the attempt record. Read .tick/runners.toml [roles.*] of the target repo for runner/model/tier the way tk herd does (contracts/runners-config-contract.json), so an operator keeps configuring runs in one place. review-epic and closeout-epic jobs run through the SAME subprocess executor at the controller checkout state (read-only source access grade for review), returning the role-result envelope (job-protocol.json) validated before the reconciler acts on it; a malformed result fails closed and leaves the process tick open.
acceptance_criteria: The three profiles resolve and are recorded with provenance; runners.toml routing is honoured with a fixture; review and closeout run as jobs on the fixture epic and their role-results validate; a malformed role-result leaves the tick open; go test -short ./... green.
